decisions.reason: Location-based margin analysis builds directly on the firm's maintained market-data and tariff know-how and still has a page of its own. With in-house R&D, the firm can interpret results and refine the product within its central platform.

The regional electricity tariff calculator is close to the firm's core tariff databases, so it can be absorbed and improved. Its drop from a page of its own to a mention, while sibling tariff products disappeared, points to consolidation, but a core calculator is likely to be retained.

The regional area definition tool builds on the firm's established network and region data and likely serves as a supporting component for other tariff and analysis applications. Despite its reduced web presence, the firm is likely to keep and integrate it.
